note: The owner's edits to printed rules text, applied before the table types a record (tools/build_typed_mechanics_authority.py sources; factory_authoring/owner_text_edits.py): each record's 'remove' lines are struck from its text, then each 'replace' pair's 'old' words (printed exactly once) become its 'new' words. A 'replace' that changes only numbers keeps the record's typing: the builder types the text as it read before and carries that typing onto the edited numbers (quoted evidence re-quoted, the typed field holding the old number changed), and reports any record it cannot carry. Combat blocks read the typed record's numbers (combat/rules/feature_blocks.json 'typed'), so one edit here reaches the hover text, the typed record and the table. The sealed catalog (catalog_authority) and sealed character packages keep the old wording until the next catalog release.

player_evidence.Unwilling target only. Jump-distance hal: For an unwilling creature that failed Burden's Strength saving throw, halve its jump distance. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats that saving throw; a success ends Burden on it.

TAL_THREAD_STITCH_THE_FALLING_BODY.player_text: Stitch the Falling Body: when you or a creature within your Thread ability's range falls, is pushed or pulled, or would be knocked Prone, you can use your reaction and spend 1 cultivation point (your Path resource) or expend Martial Focus (your prepared combat focus). Attach a thread to catch the creature. Reduce its falling damage by 5 times your Cultivation Level (your level in this game). You may move it up to 10 feet to a safe surface or leave it hanging from the thread. To avoid being knocked Prone, it may make a Dexterity saving throw against the triggering effect's DC or your Cultivation Save DC, whichever is higher.
TAL_THREAD_STITCH_THE_FALLING_BODY.why: SOL183: display-only projection requested by the owner; preserve the verbatim rules, reviewed evidence and typing.
